assertions.subject: erosive lichen planus

assertions.subject: Crohn's disease
assertions.quote: Crohn's disease may present with erosions of the oral cavity, vulva or perineum, or anus

assertions.subject: Autoimmune bullous diseases
assertions.quote: Autoimmune bullous diseases may present clinically identically to erosive LP
